responsibility: This definition file is the central registry for GCC’s OpenMP/OpenACC builtin functions. It enumerates the libgomp/libgoacc entry points and compiler-only builtins, assigning each builtin its internal enum name, user-visible symbol name, function type signature, and builtin attributes so the front ends and middle end can create, recognize, and lower calls for runtime services such as parallel regions, loop scheduling, tasks, synchronization, target offloading, OpenACC data management, and device queries.
